# RD Valeting
> Professional mobile car valeting and detailing service based in Swindon, Wiltshire, UK

## About
RD Valeting is Swindon and Wiltshire's trusted mobile car valeting service, delivering fully insured, high-standard vehicle care directly to your driveway. Founded by Rhys with over 5 years of proven hands-on valeting experience, we take genuine pride in every car we care for.

## Services & Pricing
- **Mini Valet** (£30, ~1 hour): Safe pH-neutral exterior hand wash, wheel face clean, interior vacuum, dash wipe, and glass clean.
- **Maintenance Wash** (£50, 1.5–2 hours): Comprehensive maintenance wash to keep your car decontaminated, glossy, and fresh.
- **Deep Clean** (£100, 3–4 hours): Full interior and exterior deep detail and reset. Seats & carpets wet-vac extracted, wheel arches decontaminated, trims dressed.
- **Full Valet & Detailing** (From £150, 5–6 hours): Complete showroom restoration, machine paint enhancement, and durable ceramic spray protection.
